title: What the ballet did for her career
summary: It gave recognition among new audiences but no club work.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: But the thing is in process of changing?
No, they say it takes Alvin about a year to finish off one of his ballets.
As a result of doing that, has anything come out of it for you?

W: I'm telling you the truth. He said, "It's like you said, you've been away a long time. This is going to help ." I said, "I don't think so." It did circulate my name a great deal because all the write-ups were sensational. But it didn't get me to working night clubs. See, I'm a jazz pianist, a jazz arranger. It didn't work anything that way but it gave me recognition among people that didn't know anything about me, in another field, the ballet, see, that would never come to a night club. But as far as getting work, no. Peter had to work like a dog to get me work.
There are no commissions coming from other ballet companies?

No. No, see they had flops with other jazz things. I guess they were afraid to try. I mean they got bad write-ups. But the mass they say is really successful, even when they do it on the tape in other cities.
